user.title: Connect SCSGATE
user.description: Enter the gateway's private/local IP address.

error.private_host_required: Use a private or local literal IP address.
error.invalid_status: Gateway returned an invalid status page.

status.title: Gateway status
status.description: Refresh gateway diagnostics. Web tools: /test, /request and /help are available at the gateway address.

device_add.title: Add device
device_add.description: Use the two-digit hexadecimal bus address. Types: 1 switch/light, 3 or 4 dimmer, 8 or 18 cover, 9 or 19 percentage cover, 11 generic, 14 alarm.

census_prepare.title: Prepare census
census_prepare.description: This changes the learned-device workflow. After confirming, operate every SCS device before starting the import.

census_start.title: Start device import
census_start.description: Confirm only after every device has generated bus traffic.

census_review.title: Confirm detected devices

census_recovery_stop.title: Stop abandoned census
census_recovery_stop.description: Use this recovery action if a previous guided flow was closed before completion.

mqtt.title: Configure gateway MQTT
mqtt.description: Credentials are sent once using unencrypted HTTP GET and are never stored by Home Assistant.

network.title: Configure gateway network
network.description: Changing Wi-Fi can make the gateway unreachable. Enter its current identifier to confirm.

callback.title: Configure HTTP callback
callback.description: The callback persists in gateway EEPROM and is sent without TLS. Queries/fragments are rejected. Type CALLBACK followed by the gateway identifier.

data.callback: Private callback URL or firmware callback path

picprog_flash.title: Flash PIC firmware
picprog_flash.description: High-risk operation. Type FLASH followed by the gateway identifier.

danger.title: Clear learned devices
danger.description: This erases the learned device table. Type CLEAR followed by the gateway identifier.

advanced.title: Advanced options
advanced.description: The broker-wide bus monitor keeps a bounded volatile MQTT activity log. Messages may reveal addresses and occupancy. Stock firmware 7.004 emits interpreted scs/... topics; raw UART SCSLOG requires firmware compiled with MQTTLOG.

error.invalid_callback: Use a private HTTP URL or valid firmware callback path.
error.census_still_running: The PIC import timed out and was stopped safely. Start the guided census again.
error.census_recovery_required: A previous census may still be active. Stop the abandoned census before starting another.
